Package settings

Source: R/settings.R
anndata_settings.Rd

anndata_settings mirrors Python's anndata.settings. Each setting is a field that is read with anndata_settings$name and set with anndata_settings$name <- value. Values are stored as R options named anndata.claude.<setting>, so options() and withr::local_options() work too, and an unset option means the default. Invalid values (and unknown setting names) raise an error of class anndata_invalid_setting_error.

Usage

anndata_settings

local_anndata_settings(new, .local_envir = parent.frame())

with_anndata_settings(new, code)

Format

anndata_settings is an environment of class anndata_settings.

Arguments

new

A named list of settings to override.

.local_envir

The environment whose exit restores the settings.

code

Code to run with the overridden settings.

Value

with_anndata_settings() returns the value of code. local_anndata_settings() returns the previous values invisibly.

Details

anndata_settings$reset() restores every default. with_anndata_settings() and local_anndata_settings() override settings temporarily, equivalent to settings.override in Python, and restore the previous values on exit even when an error occurs. Printing anndata_settings lists each setting, its value and a description.

Settings

  • remove_unused_categories (default TRUE): Whether or not to remove unused categories with factors.

  • check_uniqueness (default TRUE): Whether or not to check uniqueness of the obs indices on creation of an AnnData.

  • allow_write_nullable_strings (default NULL): Whether or not to allow writing of nullable string arrays. When NULL it behaves as Python with pandas 3 (infer_string is true). When FALSE explicitly, string arrays are written in the old, non-nullable format.

  • disallow_forward_slash_in_h5ad (default TRUE): Whether or not to disallow the / character in keys for h5ad files.

  • write_csr_csc_indices_with_min_possible_dtype (default FALSE): Write a csr or csc matrix with the minimum possible data type for indices, always unsigned integer.

  • restrict_index_types (default TRUE): Whether to force coercion to a string index upon creation of an AnnData or setting obs/var. Setting this to FALSE allows other index types, but integer indices are always converted to strings.

  • zarr_write_format (default 3): The zarr format version that write_zarr() writes. Writing version 2 is not yet supported and raises anndata_not_supported_error.

  • auto_shard_zarr_v3 (default TRUE): Whether zarr v3 arrays are sharded automatically, with a target of 1 GB uncompressed per shard. An explicit shards dataset argument overrides it and it is ignored for version 2. Shard shapes can differ from Python's, and rec-arrays are not sharded.

  • min_rows_for_chunked_h5_copy (default 1000): The least number of rows read at once when a dense X on disk is copied to a new h5ad file (a chunked source dataset raises it to its chunk length). Writing to a compressed dataset copies it chunk by chunk instead.

Omitted settings

Python's copy_on_write_X is deprecated and always on upstream, so it is omitted (copy-on-write is the only behaviour). use_sparse_array_on_read is omitted because R has no distinction between scipy sparse matrices and sparse arrays.

Examples

anndata_settings$check_uniqueness
#> [1] TRUE

with_anndata_settings(list(check_uniqueness = FALSE), {
  anndata_settings$check_uniqueness
})
#> [1] FALSE

anndata_settings$check_uniqueness <- FALSE
anndata_settings$reset()
anndata_settings
#> <anndata_settings>
#>   remove_unused_categories                       TRUE   Remove unused categories from factors
#>   check_uniqueness                               TRUE   Check uniqueness of obs names on creation
#>   allow_write_nullable_strings                   NULL   Allow writing nullable string arrays (NULL infers it)
#>   disallow_forward_slash_in_h5ad                 TRUE   Disallow `/` in keys for h5ad files
#>   write_csr_csc_indices_with_min_possible_dtype  FALSE  Write sparse indices with the minimum unsigned dtype
#>   restrict_index_types                           TRUE   Force string indices on creation and when setting obs/var
#>   zarr_write_format                              3      Zarr format version written (2 is not yet supported)
#>   auto_shard_zarr_v3                             TRUE   Shard zarr v3 arrays automatically (not yet written)
#>   min_rows_for_chunked_h5_copy                   1000   Rows copied at once from a backed dense X
